listing.name: Space Channel 5 Native
listing.summary: Register an upstream-prepared Space Channel 5 Windows player for your own USA Dreamcast GDI and retained user data.

steps.title: Complete the title’s supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the complete upstream Windows package and use its supported import/preparation with your own original USA GDI and every adjacent track. Keep the originals together and read-only. The release needs no separately installed Python, Git or compiler for normal import. Portcove does not import the disc or build a Dreamcast runtime.

steps.title: Use the matching original and setup procedure
steps.instruction: Use the exact upstream importer’s supported USA layout: a data track at LBA 45000 in Mode1/2352 and its conjunctive extracted-executable identity checks. Those checks concern the imported executable and do not establish a whole-track-set cryptographic certificate. Keep matched extracted assets and native modules; do not substitute another region or partially copied track set.

steps.title: Add the completed supported game program
steps.instruction: After upstream preparation completes, select build/sc5-native-dev.exe with the package root as working directory and the supported literal arguments --gdi followed by your absolute original GDI path. This documented native entry keeps the game harness in-process. Keep the matching build/native-diff modules and support files; do not attach an importer or an arbitrary helper.

steps.title: Review launch details and manage updates
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage setup, game replacement and recovery. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and every data location it uses. Review and select the changed executable before playing again. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, conversion, data migration or deletion for these external files.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Keep the complete working game, originals, saves, settings, mods, caches, backups and every custom data location before changing versions. Another executable may use those same locations. These instructions do not establish Portcove-managed installation, gameplay or save compatibility.

references.title: Preserve the whole creating copy and effective data
references.instruction: Keep the entire creating player, build modules, extracted files, userdata, settings, mods and original GDI/tracks. SC5_USER_ROOT can change the root used for imported files/settings, and SC5_RUNTIME_DATA can change runtime data; preserve every effective override and any custom --image, --dll or --data location. Retain GPL and per-file third-party notices. Published translated modules and their separately supplied corresponding native-aot source do not license your original game assets.
